question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

The horn of the car ahead was _________ by the resistance of the thick air.
solution:
The correct answer is: **muffled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"muffled"** means a sound that is not loud because of being obstructed in some way; muted. (मंद)

 
 
• **Example: **The thick walls muffled the sound of the traffic outside.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the horn of the car ahead was muffled by the resistance of the thick air.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **muffled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dim **(मंद): Lacking brightness or clarity.

 
 
• **Example:** The room was dimly lit by a single bulb.
 
 
 
• **Faint **(मंद): Barely perceptible.
 
 
• **Example: **She heard a faint sound coming from the basement.
 
 
 
• **Mute** (मूक): Silent or unable to speak.
 
 
• **Example:** The remote control can mute the television sound.
